mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a comfortable temperature of 74 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. Keep an eye on the sky for a waxing crescent moon and look up at 10:19 PM to spot the International Space Station passing overhead for about five minutes.

The City of Verona is offering several green initiatives, including rain barrel rebates to conserve water and free food scrap drop-offs at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop. Additionally, Alliant Energy is working with the city to proactively upgrade local streetlights to energy-efficient LEDs.

Several local events are coming up, including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Mount Horeb Art Fair on July 18th. Plus, do not miss the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market returning to Hometown Junction Park on Wednesday, July 22nd.

In local law enforcement news, last Friday morning, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle collision at Old P B and Whalen Road. The cyclist sustained minor injuries, and a Verona resident was cited for failing to yield.
You still have 30 minutes to grab tonight's delicious Mint Cookie flavor of the day before Culver's closes at 10:30 PM. If you cannot make it tonight, tomorrow's mouth-watering flavor will be Turtle!
